prompt:
Subject:
Blue bouquet and white lace

Main Subject:
A single woman standing by a wooden staircase in the center of the frame, holding a large blue and white bouquet. She is smiling in a warm, modern interior, wearing a white lace short-length outfit and thin sandals.

Character/Expression:
Face slightly tilted to the right of the frame, looking at the camera with a soft closed-mouth smile. Rounded oval face with a small chin, wide eyes and soft eyebrows, short thin nose bridge, pale rose lips, and light pink cheeks. Dark brown hair tied in a high loose bun, with transparent bangs and long loose strands hanging down the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory lace corset top and ruffled shorts integrated into a rompers. Features include thin shoulder straps, a deep V-neckline, vertical sheer inserts, a thin ribbon at the waist, tiered lace hems, and sheer long sleeves falling off the shoulders. She holds the bouquet with her right arm, left arm down, and stands with legs crossed at the ankles.

Background/Lighting:
A dark wood staircase with indirect lighting on the left, a vertical lattice in the center background, and a low table, sofa, potted plant, and small floor lamp in the back right. Warm soft light sources from the back right and above illuminate the person and flowers, keeping the wood a deep brown.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical ratio, nearly horizontal eye-level camera capturing the full body from head to toe. The person occupies most of the space from center to right, the bouquet overlaps from the left chest to the waist, and the staircase creates a vertical margin on the left. Focus is on the person and bouquet, with the living room in the background slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
A photorealistic indoor live-action photo with warm lighting. Lace, sheer sleeves, wrapping paper, flower petals, wood, and stone floors are rendered in fine, calm tones.

Negative:
omission of sheer sleeves falling from shoulders; do not make the bouquet small
